data.one_liner: Pre-built Firebase Auth UI widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑to‑use screens for email, phone, OAuth sign‑in, email verification, and more, integrating directly with Firebase Auth.
use_when: Need a quick, drop‑in authentication UI
Want to support multiple providers without custom coding
Need email verification and link sign‑in out of the box
avoid_when: Require a highly custom design or branding
strengths: Comprehensive provider support (email, phone, OAuth, Apple, Google, Twitter, Facebook)
weaknesses: Recent breaking changes in 4.0.0 require migration
